name: CD-38 1467B

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list TOI-451 and CD-38 1467B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 4844691297067063424 and 4844691297067064576), 4,669 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 8.0e-6: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to TOI-451, 4,669 AU away.

radius.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the radius of TIC 257605132 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

mass.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the mass of TIC 257605132 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

temperature.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the effective temperature of TIC 257605132 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

text.card: CD-38 1467B is a star of 3,418 K, bound to TOI-451 4,669 AU away.
text.introduction: CD-38 1467B shares its motion through space with TOI-451, 4,669 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: CD-38 1467B's orbit around TOI-451 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
